locales.description: The site languages, the default one first by convention.

defaultLocale.description: One of `locales`: served at the site root.

name.description: The business name exactly as it is known.

brand.description: The business as the site names it.

label.description: A one- or two-word menu label, e.g. "Services". One entry per site locale, at most 24 characters each.

navigation.description: The main menu: up to 7 pages, in order.

pages.description: The pages: a home page (slug "") and up to seven more.

assets.description: Every image the site uses, on our storage.

title.description: The site title, e.g. "Café Saint-Jean". One entry per site locale, at most 70 characters each.

description.description: What the business is and where (120–160 characters). One entry per site locale, at most 200 characters each.

seo.description: The site-wide search title and description.

noindex.description: Keep search engines out (true for previews).

previewBanner.description: Show the "concept preview" banner (true for previews).

analytics.description: Visit counting: cookieless (no consent banner needed) or none.

enabled.description: Offer the contact form (messages reach the agency, then the business).

settings.description: Site-wide settings. A preview keeps noindex and the preview banner on.

style.description: Overall design family: luxe (refined, serif, generous space), modern (clean, geometric), warm (friendly, earthy), minimal (sparse, typographic), coastal (light, airy, sea tones).

pairId.description: A curated heading/body font pair. Prefer one that suits the theme style (see the block catalog).

radius.description: Corner rounding of buttons, cards and images.

Theme.description: Visual theme: one style family, a palette, a font pair and a few tokens.

primary.description: Brand colour for buttons and large accents (#rrggbb); body links use the text colour. Needs 3:1 on the background, and black or white must reach 4.5:1 on it (button labels).

secondary.description: Optional second brand colour for large areas (#rrggbb). Needs 3:1 on the background.

accent.description: Small accents: icons, rules, badges (#rrggbb). Needs 3:1 contrast on the background.

background.description: Page background (#rrggbb). Usually very light (or very dark for a dark theme).

surface.description: Cards and panels on the background (#rrggbb).

text.description: Body text (#rrggbb). Needs 4.5:1 contrast on the background and on the surface.

mutedText.description: Secondary text such as captions (#rrggbb). Needs 4.5:1 on the background and on the surface.

Palette.description: The site palette. Pick colours from the business (logo, photos) and keep text readable.

value.description: The phone number in E.164, e.g. "+590590270000".

factId.description: The fact this value comes from (required: never invent a contact detail).
